text:
Tom (Finance): Heads up: Brightline submitted a billing dispute for April 304. They say their side shows ~2.4M embeddings but our invoice lists ~2.0M. Requesting a line-level breakdown and a proposed remediation. Ticket: https://go/recon/T-1987
Noor (Data Ops): I'll pull raw vs canonical counts. initial hunch: batching/chunking without stable chunk_id might double-count when retries occur.
Ken (Eng): We rolled a rate-limiter tweak on 2026-04-02 that changed how partial batch retries are surfaced. older clients that didn't include chunk_id can cause reprocessing of partial batches.
Olivia (Billing): Our invoice generation uses the canonical deduped table (billing_view) which relies on event.chunk_id to de-duplicate. if chunk_id is missing duplicates could survive. need data proof.
Zoe (SRE): There was a brief spike and consumer rebalance on 2026-04-02 09:14 UTC; partition X lagged and we rebalanced which may have replayed in-flight batches. I logged the incident: infra-789.
Noor (Data Ops): running queries now.
Noor (Data Ops): query (raw count):
```
SELECT customer, COUNT(*) as raw_count FROM embeddings_stream
WHERE customer='brightline' AND ts >= '2026-04-01' AND ts < '2026-05-01' GROUP BY customer;
```
Noor (Data Ops): query (deduped):
```
SELECT customer, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(chunk_id, request_id)) as deduped_count FROM embeddings_stream
WHERE customer='brightline' AND ts >= '2026-04-01' AND ts < '2026-05-01' GROUP BY customer;
```
Noor (Data Ops): results: raw_count=2,432,210; deduped_count=2,001,543; delta=430,667.
Tom (Finance): thanks. What's estimated dollar impact?
Olivia (Billing): current embedding rate for Brightline tier is $0.00035/embedding. rough credit = 430,667 * 0.00035 = $150.73. will compute exact after audit (taxes/discounts).
Legal (Contracts): we require a signed credit memo + brief acceptance of correction from customer before applying. I'll prepare template.
Ken (Eng): short-term mitigation: reject events without chunk_id at edge and add a header enforcement. longer-term: backfill dedupe using request_fingerprint and sequence windows.
Noor (Data Ops): proposed steps: 1) run dry-run backfill that computes per-customer billed_delta using canonical dedupe logic; 2) produce audit bundle (raw events, dedupe logs, rebalance window); 3) share with Finance + Legal; 4) run approved correction. Sample backfill SQL: 
```
INSERT INTO billing_adjustments (customer, month, raw_cnt, deduped_cnt, delta, run_tag)
SELECT customer, '2026-04', COUNT(*) as raw_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(chunk_id, request_id)) as deduped_cnt, COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(chunk_id, request_id)) as delta, 'run-179200'
FROM embeddings_stream
WHERE customer='brightline' AND ts >= '2026-04-01' AND ts < '2026-05-01'
GROUP BY customer;
```
Olivia (Billing): approvals needed: Finance + Legal sign-off to generate memo and apply either an immediate credit or next-invoice adjustment. Also confirm we want to round credit to nearest cent.
Tom (Finance): Approve dry-run + audit bundle. Please include a customer-friendly one-paragraph explanation and the exact numeric reconciliation.
Legal (Contracts): Approved to prepare credit memo. we'll require customer's signed acceptance before issuing.
Zoe (SRE): I'll schedule the dry-run during low-traffic window: 2026-04-10 01:00-02:30 UTC. I'll capture consumer offsets and produce replay-safe artifacts.
Ken (Eng): we'll also push a telemetry patch that surfaces events missing chunk_id to a diagnostic topic; will open PR and include recommended client change note.
Olivia (Billing): tagging @accounts-bot to flag invoice for review.
accounts-bot: Invoice BR-2026-04 now marked 'investigating' by Tom (Finance)  case T-1987.
Tom (Finance): please post dry-run artifacts and draft credit memo to ticket when ready. I'll draft the customer email after review. :white_check_mark:
